title: Japanese Shio Ramen with Roasted Potato
description: A hearty and comforting Japanese-inspired ramen dish featuring roasted potato and a rich shio broth.
instructions: Peel the russet potato and cut it into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
In a large pot, combine warm water and shio ramen broth mix. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat to a simmer.
Add soy sauce to the pot and stir to combine.
Cook Japanese ramen noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
To assemble, place cooked noodles in a bowl, then add roasted potato and hot broth.
